done_when: forge read refuses a story doc with more than six Done when lines, saying in one line to split it into smaller stories; approved stories already over six are left alone. New and existing client repos get it on init or upgrade plus sync, and a test covers both.

findings.body: Raise: Not done. If a story has an earlier cold-read finding without a disposition, then its plan is revised from six to seven Done when items, `forge read` refuses at lines 160–162 before reaching this limit check. It prints the two-line disposition error instead of the required one-line message to split the story. This is a normal planning revision that the fresh-story and approved-story tests do not cover.
findings.title: Not done: forge read does not give the split message on a later read

why: Big plans give readers too much to pick at
